items.title: Gucci cuts prices, but will Chinese shoppers return?
items.summary: Jing Daily (by Lisa Nan) reports Kering's Gucci has cut prices on handbags and ready-to-wear in China as consumer confidence weakens; cautious shoppers are described as waiting for further reductions and favoring gold over logo bags instead.

items.source: Weibo (古驰保值吗？2026年官方降价40%后...)
items.title: 古驰保值吗？2026年官方降价40%后，哪些款式还能扛价？
items.summary: Weibo fashion-content account breaks down which Gucci bag styles still hold resale value after the brand's official up-to-40% China price cuts, warning that boutique price drops are dragging secondhand resale prices down in parallel (e.g., Ophidia bucket bag resale potentially falling to 4,000-5,000 RMB).

items.source: Weibo (中国制造的Gucci运动鞋定价七千元...)
items.title: 中国制造的Gucci运动鞋定价七千元，性价比如何？
items.summary: Weibo account "潮流手记" discusses the ~1,050 USD / 7,050 RMB Gucci Drip sneaker made in China, noting Gucci frames the choice as technical capability rather than cost-cutting and that 95% of Gucci production remains in Italy; argues value judgment is shifting from obsessing over origin to overall design/brand value.

items.source: DC Inside (dcbest - 싱글벙글 명품 브랜드 구찌 근황)
items.title: 싱글벙글 명품 브랜드 구찌 근황
items.summary: Korean community (DC Inside 실시간 베스트) thread mocks Gucci's reported revenue decline and its move to sell China-made products as cost-cutting, framing it as emblematic of broader luxury-sector struggles; tone is critical/cynical.

items.title: "진짜 맞나요?" 1000달러 구찌 신발에 '메이드 인 차이나'...무슨 일이
items.summary: Nate News reports Korean consumers discovered Gucci Primavera-line items priced around 120,000-130,000 won carrying 'Made in China' labels instead of the expected 'Made in Italy,' raising authenticity concerns; Gucci says country of origin can differ from manufacturing site without affecting quality, but an analyst says luxury brand reputation hinges on perceived origin.

items.title: 피렌체 장인정신 버렸나... 구찌가 '중국산 스니커즈' 출시한 속사정
items.summary: Insight reports on Gucci's Demna-designed 'Drip' sneaker (about 800 euros/$1,000) made in China, noting Gucci's defense that Italy remains core to its identity and the China move reflects manufacturer technical capability, set against the backdrop of Kering revenue roughly halving over three years and store closures.

items.title: 賛否両論のデムナの「グッチ」は10点満点中の何点？業界アナリストが辛口リポート
items.summary: WWD Japan (translated from WWD US by Kyoko Iguchi) relays Bernstein analyst Luca Solca's AI-assisted scoring of Demna's Gucci runway debut at 7.6/10 -- an improvement on the prior creative director's 6.8 debut score but 'not a home run'; jackets and trousers passed, but shoes and handbags were called boring and the overall look lacked elegance.

items.title: Kering 주가 하락, 경영진의 신중한 전망 제시
items.summary: Investing.com Korea reports Kering shares fell as much as 5% intraday on Oct 2 after a sell-side analyst call turned more cautious than the H1 2026 results tone and did not formally reiterate guidance; Citi cut its Kering price target from 282 to 243 euros even as management cited progress on Gucci pricing architecture and brand desirability ahead of Q3 earnings (Oct 22).

items.source: Insideretail Australia (via regional luxury wire pickup relevant to NEA manufacturing angle)
items.title: Why Gucci's 'Made in China' sneakers are raising questions
items.summary: Report details Gucci's Drip sneaker and a leather slip-on model both carrying 'Made in China' labels; analysts quoted include Berenberg flagging tension between provenance and luxury positioning, consultant Simon Whitehouse saying 'Made in China is not a good look,' and Barclays' Carole Madjo noting customers may ask whether to keep buying Gucci as prices and provenance shift simultaneously.

items.title: 구찌, 2026 가을·겨울 아이웨어 새 시선
items.summary: Money Today covers Gucci's F/W 2026 eyewear campaign, art-directed by Riccardo Zanola and shot by Mark Seliger, featuring portraits of people absorbed in their own pastimes; men's line centers black rectangular sunglasses and black acetate optical frames with horsebit-motif temples.

items.title: 구찌의 본질을 자신만의 언어로 재정의한 뎀나, '더 스토어 쇼(The Store Show)'
items.summary: GQ Korea covers Demna's Milan Fashion Week 'The Store Show,' staged as a mock Gucci retail space, presenting archetypes like 'The Rebellious Aristocrat' and 'The Snob'; Demna states it took him a year to truly understand what Gucci means, with new Uptown horsebit tote iterations and bamboo-handle bags among the accessories shown.

items.title: 新浪时尚热点小时报丨2026年10月02日11时
items.summary: Sina's hourly fashion-trending digest logs Weibo-hot-search-adjacent consumer comparison topics including 'Gucci vs Prada bag, which to choose' and a Gucci-vs-Cartier wedding-watch budget comparison, indicating ongoing organic buzz around Gucci as a comparison/reference brand in Chinese social commerce chatter.

items.title: 구찌는 왜 브랜드가 휘청이게 되었을까에 대해
items.summary: Korean community (Clien) analytical thread argues Gucci's brand crisis stems from chasing mass-market trendiness and democratizing luxury, which produced image fatigue; cites an approximately 25% YoY Q1 sales decline across Asia/Europe/Korea at the time and contrasts Gucci's exposure with resilient ultra-luxury houses serving wealthy-only ecosystems; comments also raise counterfeit proliferation and celebrity-association damage.
